messages:
Anya: FYI customer Helios Health hit a blocker during the SI handoff — their security team refuses go-live until telemetry doesn't contain PII and there's an explicit consent toggle. can we triage?
Mike: what payloads are flagged exactly?
Sara: security sent examples. telemetry.events.identify currently includes user_email and session_id. they want email hashed + consent flag, and an auditable change log for private deploy.
Leo: the SI connector (EdgeWorks) is on agent v0.9.1 which emits raw email. SDK v0.9.2 has a --redact-email / email_hashing option. SI needs to upgrade, cc @Jordan for release coordination.
Jordan: I can coordinate with EdgeWorks. Q: can we patch server-side to mask emails short-term so customer can proceed?
Anya: yes, we can add a prefix-mask in ingestion to temporarily strip email, but that will break per-user rollups (analytics). customer preferred hashing so rollups still work.
Mike: timeline note — go-live scheduled tomorrow. recommendation: two-step: 1) enable server-side prefix mask to unblock immediate go-live, 2) ship agent upgrade (0.9.2) with consent flag and hashing as durable fix. Need sec sign-off.
Sara: customer sec insists consent must be opt-in (default off) for data capture in their environment, and they want a short runbook + proof of hashing.
Leo: will EdgeWorks accept default off? they have some telemetry relied-on for monitoring. I can draft PR to add telemetry.consent (default=false) and email_hashing:true.
Jordan: PR draft posted: https://github.com/redwood/si-edge-connector/pull/482 — adds telemetry.consent config + migration notes.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for si-edge-connector 0.9.2 at 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC
Anya: another hiccup — marketplace image signature rotated yesterday and EdgeWorks installer fails verification unless they pull latest pubkey. SI asked for a signed fingerprint to validate. can infra provide one?
Mike: infra can produce a signed fingerprint file. @Leo add that fingerprint step to partner onboarding doc and send to EdgeWorks. cc legal for notification.
Leo: on it. also adding a short checklist for future handoffs: (1) telemetry consent feature flag + default, (2) agent upgrade plan + canary window, (3) signed pubkey distribution and verification steps, (4) customer sec runbook with sample hashes and audit steps.
Sara: customer asked for a tiny sample script to show hashed email output. sample: ```python
import hashlib
email = 'user@example.com'
print(hashlib.sha256(email.encode()).hexdigest())
```
Jordan: created quick canary rollback plan: if canary failure > 1% errors within 30m -> rollback to 0.9.1 and enable temporary server-side mask. will post to #release-war-room if triggered.
Anya: action items recap: Jordan -> finalize PR + run canary; Leo -> send pubkey + update onboarding doc; Sara -> draft the customer runbook + sample hash proof; Mike -> enable/verify server-side mask and confirm retention/rollup impact. I will ping EdgeWorks and legal for sign-off.
Anya: please react with :thumbsup: once you have your task in progress so I can update the customer.
Mike: :thumbsup:
Jordan: :thumbsup:
Leo: :thumbsup:
Sara: :thumbsup:
